paths.title: Death record to frozen successors, compatibility filters, chosen character and functional traits

claims.observation: GameOverScreen.OnEnter appends the deceased character with class/traits/age/kills/boss record, clears candidate branches, marks IsDead and resets run flags, Lich gains and the one-reroll flag. FreeEntrance and five challenge tokens survive where other special items are removed; death does not reset manor/equipment arrays or Gold in this observed boundary.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

claims.observation: LoadCurrentBranches generates three candidates only when CurrentBranches is absent/empty, stores candidate class/spell/traits/age/portrait and saves Lineage; otherwise restores existing candidates. Candidate generation calls LineageObj with createEmpty=false. This prevents ordinary screen reopen from intentionally regenerating offers, subject to actual save success.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

claims.observation: CreateRandomTraits reuses ONE inclusive 0..100 roll for both thresholds: first <94, second <55; so code-derived probability is 55/101 two traits, 39/101 one, 7/101 none. Rarity cutoffs are cumulative 48/85/100 with <= and inclusive RNG, yielding 49/101,37/101,15/101, rather than exactly 48/37/15 percent. Duplicate second traits and five incompatible pairs are rejected.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

claims.observation: GetRandomClass starts Knight/Wizard/Barbarian/Assassin; manor unlocks add Ninja/Banker/SpellSword/Lich/Dragon, and final challenge/config gate adds Traitor. The uniform candidate-class selection upgrades ordinary class IDs by +8 when the corresponding retained manor skill is purchased. The pool is progression-dependent, not level-matched to an enemy.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

claims.observation: After drawing traits and class, constructor rerolls traits for Lich+Dextrocardia and Wizard/Wizard2/Dragon+Savant. Spell is drawn from class list; Savant rejects DamageShield/TimeStop/Translocator. Age18..30 and childAge2..5 are presentation-generation fields here, not simulated played-time aging.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

claims.observation: Confirm at current branch offers a warning dialog with StartGame or CancelSelection; cancellation restores the temporary IsFemale stat. Purchased Randomize_Children and RerolledChildren=false permit one reroll: sets/saves the used flag, then clears/regenerates/saves branches. Those saves are separate calls. StartGame copies the selected identity/class/traits/spell, initializes Wizard spell list, clears branches and loads StartingRoom.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

claims.observation: Dextrocardia exchanges which full computed HP/MP stat pool MaxHealth/MaxMana uses, including gear, global purchase-level growth, permanent stat pickups, manor stats and class multipliers. Hyperactive adds a movement multiplier term. These are functional consumers, not proof that every listed trait changes every system.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

claims.observation: Lineage save/load carries candidate identity/class/spell/traits and history. SavePlayerData/LoadPlayerData separately persist current class/spell/traits. SaveFiles catches errors and increments a failure count, displaying an error after repeated failures; no all-files atomicity is established.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

trace.caller: Player death -> GameOverScreen.OnEnter -> LineageScreen.OnEnter/LoadCurrentBranches -> chosen confirmation StartGame -> StartingRoom player refill/save
gates: Three offers created only if missing; existing offer data loaded
Class pool uses retained unlock/upgrade checks
Reroll needs purchase and unused generation flag; confirmation is cancellable
costs: No per-selection currency deduction in StartGame
Randomize_Children is a one-level manor purchase; reroll uses one generation allowance
Run ends in death, losing the selected body/run gains but retaining catalog/manor/history
mutations: Death appends history, clears candidates, sets IsDead and resets run gains
Reroll saves used flag before separately replacing saved offers
Selected candidate replaces class/traits/spell identity; StartingRoom refills computed HP/MP
consumers: Class-specific spell list and later PlayerObj spell execution
Manor unlocks alter later candidate pool
failure_boundaries: Repeated SaveFiles failure is surfaced; separate file calls are not proven atomic
trace.persistence: Source serialization covers history, candidates and current identity. No descendant lifecycle or death/save test was run.

paths.title: Run gold to retained paid manor choices, class/service options and next-run toll

claims.observation: SkillObj.TotalCost = BaseCost + CurrentLevel*Appreciation + 10*Game.PlayerStats.CurrentLevel. ModifierAmount=CurrentLevel*PerLevelModifier. Health_Up is +10 per purchased level, base50/appreciation40/max75; every successful manor purchase increases global CurrentLevel, so even unrelated purchases raise later prices and can increase player HP/MP through level growth.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

claims.observation: Initialize starts Smithy visible. Navigation permits non-null visible skills; confirm checks enough gold and below MaxLevel and m_fadingIn=false, deducts gold then reveals manor/neighbor icons and increments skill/global level. Insufficient gold emits purchase failure; capped skills cannot be purchased. The immediate per-purchase save call is commented; actual OnExit saves UpgradeData and PlayerData.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

claims.observation: Ninja_Unlock costs base400 plus global purchase-level surcharge, max1, and changes future random-class eligibility. Randomize_Children costs base5000 plus global surcharge, max1, and enables one reroll for each successor generation. These purchases grant action/selection options as well as numerical stats.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

claims.observation: Gold is not cleared by GameOverScreen death block. At next StartingRoom, toll is available only after TimesDead>0 and collector still visible. Confirming TollPaid(true) removes int(currentGold*(1 - Prices_Down.ModifierAmount)); FreeEntrance uses TollPaid(false). Thus unspent gold loss occurs at the confirmed gate, not universally on death. Challenge tokens are consumed there into specific challenge-unlocked flags.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

claims.observation: Retained Architect skill makes service available. Player confirmation requires a saved Map and an unlocked castle. ActivateArchitect leads to LockCastle=true and HasArchitectFee=true, resets FAILED fairy chests and breakables. Missing map refuses service, cancellation keeps layout choice unchanged, and entry clears invalid fee when no map exists. Actual map reload and 0.6 money-pickup multiplier are traced by manor.architect-consumers rather than inferred from this flag.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

claims.observation: Upgrade save writes discovery/purchase/equipped arrays and skill levels. Upgrade load resets skill/global counters then calls LevelUpTrait(saved levels, false), reconstructing progress without replaying any gold bonus. Death reset excludes these arrays, while StartingRoom restores computed HP/MP and saves alive status. SaveFiles writes individual types with catch-based failure reporting; do not copy this as YAIR transaction proof.
claims.limits: Pinned code observation; no game execution or save/reload verification.

claims.observation: On castle loading LockCastle selects saved LoadMap plus MapData, then clears LockCastle only after restoration. Locked reload suppresses ordinary-enemy killed-state, breakable-broken and fairy-failed restoration, while opened chest state still restores. Money pickup applies round(amount*(1+TotalGoldBonus)*0.6) when HasArchitectFee, compared with multiplier1 normally. This is the actual reduced-earnings consumer; architecture retains layout with selected run-state resets, not arbitrary world rewind.
claims.limits: Source branch/rounding observation only; room assets, save replay and play unverified.

trace.caller: Selected successor StartGame -> StartingRoom loaded under SkillScreen -> visible authored skill -> confirm purchase -> exit save -> full-stat character -> toll -> castle entry
gates: Enough gold, skill below cap, not fading
Architect needs a saved layout; toll only after a prior death
costs: Architect keeps layout for downstream reduced gold earnings, not upfront fee in inspected activation
mutations: Gold deduction; permanent manor/global levels; neighboring options revealed
Selected successor stat consumers recompute from retained purchases
Entry consumes toll/token and may preserve map
consumers: Layout reuse and income multiplier paths cross P4/P5
failure_boundaries: Exit-save errors are caught rather than providing rollback atomicity
trace.persistence: Separate binary PlayerData/UpgradeData/Map/Lineage files and reconstructed skill levels. Exact save compatibility/build/play behavior unperformed.
